subject: PO number alignment and spend cap for CloudArc onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@cloudarc.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@ceivatech.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: PO number + spend cap (CloudArc)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Procurement is ready to move us forward but needs the following to generate the formal PO from our side:

- Confirmed Redwood PO number mapping (so it shows in our ledger)
- The spend cap that Redwood will commit to for the first 90 days
- A short SOW line breakdown (we need to map amounts to two ledger buckets: Platform Usage and Professional Services)

I’ve attached the onboarding form — I filled what I could but left the PO number and spend cap blank since we don’t have the canonical Redwood PO reference. Our internal finance team requires the PO number at issuance or a provisional allocation to lock funds.

Can you advise who on your side owns PO issuance and whether you can provisionally lift the spend cap to $50,000 for initial ramp? If we can get a provisional PO number, we’ll start the vendor setup and routing in our AP system.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Procurement, CloudArc
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@cloudarc.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number + spend cap (CloudArc)

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary of where we are and next steps: 

- PO issuance owner: Monica (procurement ops) manages the PO lifecycle and tagging. Monica — can you confirm token/ponum mapping cadence?
- Provisional spend: We can provisionally allocate up to $50k for the first 90 days but need a signed onboarding form + a short email confirming SOW split to lock it.
- Line split: We will issue a single PO with two top-level line items (Platform Usage / Professional Services). If CloudArc prefers separate PO lines for each budget center, we can split at issuance — let us know the preferred split.

Irene — please add the internal ledger code that must land on the PO metadata (we need to ensure CloudArc’s AP can reconcile). Also attaching our PO template for reference.

Action items:
1) Monica: hold provisional PO # placeholder and prepare ponum_assignment_20260723.csv mapping.
2) Elena: return signed onboarding form + confirm SOW split.
3) Finance (Irene): confirm ledger code and any tax jurisdiction note.

I’ll follow up Thursday if we haven’t got the signed doc.

Thanks — Markus
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_po_template.docx
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, Elena Soto <elena.soto@cloudarc.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number + spend cap (CloudArc)

Hi all — jumping in on the PO side.

Notes and what I’ve done so far:
- I reserved provisional PO placeholder: PRV-20260723-CLDARC and added it to our staging ledger. This is sufficient for CloudArc to start vendor setup but we need the signed onboarding form within 72 hours to convert to a formal PO.
- I created a mapping CSV (attached) that ties PRV-20260723-CLDARC to internal ledger code LEDG-61-PLAT (Platform Usage) and LEDG-61-PS (Professional Services).
- Regarding spend cap: I’ve pre-authorized a provisional spend envelope of $50,000. Finance will only finalize the commitment after verification of tax jurisdiction and W9 (or equivalent).

Open questions for CloudArc:
- Can you confirm the intended split between Platform vs. Services? I put a tentative 70/30 split ($35k platform / $15k services) pending your confirmation.
- Elena: we’re missing tax form on the onboarding PDF (page 2). Please attach W9 (US) or W-8BEN as applicable.

If you confirm the split and send the signed PDF + tax form, I’ll convert PRV-20260723-CLDARC -> PO-20260723-4821 and email the formal PO number to your AP team.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ponum_assignment_20260723.csv
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@cloudarc.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@ceivatech.com
Date: 2026-07-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number + spend cap (CloudArc)

Thanks Monica — that provisional flow works for us. I’ve attached the corrected onboarding form (signed) and our W9. Confirming we accept the 70/30 split you proposed.

A couple notes for your ledger team:
- Our AP system requires the PO number in the 'External Reference' field and the vendor tax id included in the metadata block; please ensure both are present on conversion.
- For the professional services line, please split the single line into two sub-lines on your internal ledger reflecting milestone 1 (kickoff/integration) and milestone 2 (optimization). We will map each sub-line to separate cost centers on our side.

If you convert the provisional PRV-20260723-CLDARC to PO-20260723-4821 with the two sub-lines and metadata, we’ll route to AP and start payment terms processing.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form_v2_signed.pdf, CloudArc_W9.pdf

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Procurement, CloudArc
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@cloudarc.com>
Date: 2026-07-23T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number + spend cap (CloudArc)

Perfect — thanks Elena and Monica. Monica, please proceed with conversion and include LEDG-61-PLAT / LEDG-61-PS as top-level lines, and then split PS into sub-line PS-01 (Kickoff) and PS-02 (Optimization). Add the External Reference field with the final PO number and the vendor tax id metadata.

Irene — confirm once the accounting entry posts so I can close the onboarding checklist.

I’ll send a short note to Customer Success to schedule the initial kickoff once PO-20260723-4821 is live.

-Markus
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
